display.title: Episode 535: The Ten Wedding Gifts, Chapter 2
display.summary_short: Summer vacation begins: Uncle Yossi's three daily pillars, a yeshiva boy leads the Shema, and the Baal Shem Tov arrives at the wedding with ten students and ten mysterious gifts.
display.summary_long: Broadcast at the start of summer vacation 5752. Uncle Yossi reminds listeners of the three things the world stands on, Torah, avodah and gemilus chasadim: learn Torah, daven and give tzedakah every day, and take your pushka along wherever you go. After the Hakochainik march, a yeshiva boy leads the Shema and everyone drops coins in the pushka. Story time continues 'Rabbi Yisrael Baal Shem Tov and the Ten Wedding Gifts'. As the wedding of Avraham and Sarah is about to begin, a holy-looking rabbi walks in with ten students. Reuven, the kind host, asks him to say the brachos under the chuppah, and at the meal the guest reveals that he is the Baal Shem Tov, sent to bless them for their good deeds. Each student then 'gives' the couple a property belonging to one poritz or another, and the visitors vanish in a wagon with no driver. After a sponsor message, listeners say Tehillim for the Rebbe's recovery. Uncle Yossi then explains that we inherit the midos of Avraham, Yitzchak and Yaakov, and urges children to practice Avraham's chesed with new friends this summer. The show ends with the summer Mitzvah Mission charts and candle-lighting time.
display.lesson: Torah, davening and tzedakah every day keep both the world and you standing; and like Avraham Avinu, use the summer to do kindness for others.

date.note: 'First week of our summer vacation'; candle-lighting 8:11 fits Friday 3 July 1992; Rebbe refuah prayers = 5752; two weeks before 537 ('today is Yud-Gimmel Tammuz', 14 July 1992).
